answer: One concrete defense is a staked, serialized identity ledger. Each new agent locks an opal deposit that is slashed the instant it attests beside a twin, while enrollment passes through a single lagoon queue admitting only one hardware-backed root per epoch, so a hundred clones wait a hundred epochs. Rewards require a rotating willow quorum of older agents to vouch over time. The attacker must fund every deposit up front, sit out the queue, and still collect nothing from duplicates, turning a Sybil flood into a guaranteed loss.
